evals.prompt: Quiero entender cómo está organizado el sistema de plugins en este repositorio. Cómo se registran, cómo se descubren las skills y agents, y cómo se relacionan entre sí los 4 plugins.
evals.expected_output: A structured research document covering plugin architecture, plugin.json files, marketplace.json, skill/agent registration, and inter-plugin relationships.
expectations: The document mentions all 4 plugins by name: stepwise-core, stepwise-git, stepwise-web, stepwise-research
The document references plugin.json and/or marketplace.json files
The document includes concrete file paths with extensions (e.g., core/skills/..., .claude-plugin/plugin.json)
The document has YAML frontmatter with date, researcher, and git_commit fields
The document describes how skills are registered (SKILL.md as entrypoint or plugin.json configuration)
The document does NOT contain improvement recommendations, suggestions for changes, or critique of the implementation

evals.prompt: Investiga cómo funciona el sistema de thoughts-management: qué scripts tiene, cómo se inicializa el directorio thoughts/, y qué metadata genera.
evals.expected_output: A research document detailing thoughts-management scripts (thoughts-init, thoughts-metadata), directory structure, and metadata generation.
expectations: The document mentions both scripts: thoughts-init and thoughts-metadata
The document describes the thoughts/ directory structure (shared/, personal user directories)
The document includes concrete file paths to the scripts (e.g., core/skills/thoughts-management/scripts/thoughts-init)
The document has YAML frontmatter with date, researcher, and git_commit fields
The document describes what metadata the scripts generate (date, branch, commit, repository info, etc.)
The document does NOT contain improvement recommendations, suggestions for changes, or critique of the implementation

evals.prompt: Necesito entender el flujo completo de la skill create-plan. Lee el archivo core/skills/create-plan/SKILL.md y documenta qué agentes usa, en qué orden, y cómo genera el plan final.
evals.expected_output: A research document that first reads the specified file, then documents the full create-plan workflow including agent usage and plan generation.
expectations: The document explicitly mentions core/skills/create-plan/SKILL.md as a source
The document lists the agents used by create-plan (e.g., codebase-locator, codebase-analyzer, codebase-pattern-finder)
The document describes the order/flow of steps in the create-plan workflow
The document has YAML frontmatter with date, researcher, and git_commit fields
The document includes at least 3 concrete file paths with extensions
The document does NOT contain improvement recommendations, suggestions for changes, or critique of the implementation
